from.place: Statement and proof: canonical section, coefficient and boundary constructions.

title: Canonical section, Kummer and comparison data
statement: The fixed rank-one calculation uses derived evaluation in ModuleCat A, the kernel support complex and its resolution-normalized snake boundary, the coefficient image of the actual Kummer extension under the normalized Ext comparison, and the unit-induced etale to pro-etale section comparison. These are the existing definitions formerly in [thm-pur-rank-one-local-calculation], with all maps and signs unchanged. The curried section functor has the standard additive and finite-limit-preserving instances, definitionally those of explicit evaluation.

proof.text: These are the explicit existing constructions: evaluation, the restriction kernel, the short complex, its snake boundary and the canonical coefficient comparisons. All three objects of the short complex are specified explicitly, which changes no map or object.
